annotations.title: Compile a sentence into a Task plan

description: Runs the compiler over a sentence and returns the PROPOSED plan (or repair-grade problems — fix by refining the sentence with the user, not by guessing). Nothing persists. Present the proposal in plain terms: which clauses run flows, which you will handle, who decides, what the compiler noted. `computer.sites` lists sites the plan names and whether the Task allows them; workbench_tasks_set_sites asks an admin to allow the rest. Then iterate or freeze. Compile may take ~15s.

approvalId.description: Re-call with the approvalId from a needs_confirmation response after the user approves.

taskId.description: The task this sentence belongs to, when compiling an edit — keeps it out of the child-task candidates.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.
